name: Pumasi Agent
summary: Free AI models, working as a team
description: A macOS and Windows app where a lead model splits the job and free models do the work. With Pumasi, other users can take a task off your hands with their own free keys, sealed so no one in between can read it. A free model you can run here, Nemotron 3.5 Super, outscored ChatGPT's free tier on three program-graded exams.
features: Team mode: a lead splits work, free models do it
Pumasi: others run your tasks on their free keys
Free Nemotron Super beat ChatGPT free on 3 exams
Switches free providers when one hits its limit
Keys locked in the OS keychain, never shown again
English and Korean, macOS and Windows

evidence.note: Measurements in bench/README.md: Nemotron 3.5 Super alone (free API) 30/30 on a fresh reasoning exam, 28/30 on AIME 2026, 23/25 on LiveBench logic; ChatGPT free 23, 24, 13.4. Asking several models the same question did not beat Super alone. Pumasi ships in v0.1.10.
